description: This Go source file implements HTTP handlers for executing, monitoring, and updating the status of agent-initiated executions in a distributed system. It includes synchronous and asynchronous execution handling, webhook integration, event publishing, and internal payload management.

classes.name: executionController
classes.description: Controller for handling execution-related HTTP requests, managing execution lifecycle, event publishing, and webhook triggers.

classes.name: asyncExecutionJob
classes.description: Represents a job for asynchronously executing an agent request.

methods.name: handleSync
methods.description: Handles synchronous execution requests, including initiating execution, waiting for completion if needed, and returning result.

methods.name: handleAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous execution requests, enqueuing execution jobs into a worker pool.

methods.name: handleStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and result of a specific execution.

methods.name: handleBatchStatus
methods.description: Retrieves statuses of multiple executions in a batch.

methods.name: handleStatusUpdate
methods.description: Processes status callbacks (update events) from agents, updating execution records accordingly.

methods.name: prepareExecution
methods.description: Prepares an execution plan, validates agent, webhook, input, and constructs execution record.

methods.name: callAgent
methods.description: Sends an HTTP POST request to the agent to begin execution and interprets response.

methods.name: completeExecution
methods.description: Updates execution record to terminal state upon completion with result data.

methods.name: failExecution
methods.description: Updates execution record upon failure or error, with retry logic.

methods.name: publishExecutionEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event indicating execution state change.

methods.name: publishExecutionStartedEvent
methods.description: Emits an event for execution start with context.

methods.name: waitForExecutionCompletion
methods.description: Blocks until an execution completes or times out, listening on the event bus.
